title: Unit Event — At The End of The Unraveled Thread — Episode7 A Tangled Up String

meta.Event: At The End of The Unraveled Thread
meta.Event Outline: MORE MORE JUMP! is all set for their first TV appearance. However, the show's MC just happens to be the leader of the very group Shizuku used to be in, Cheerful * Days. As excited as she was about making their shoot a success, this surprise reunion has Shizuku...

rows.Line: TV Station - Studio

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: Okay, now that you've all had a chance to take your seats, we'll give a brief overview of what this segment involves!

rows.Speaker: Marina
rows.Line: In this segment, we bring on a variety of idol groups that everyone's talking about right now, including rising stars to those who've been around the block, and ask them some really juicy personal questions♪

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: To be fair, outside of Minori, MORE MORE JUMP! is comprised of veteran idols.

rows.Speaker: Marina
rows.Line: But you guys don't belong to an agency, right? Wasn't it really hard to put on a successful solo show the way you did?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Oh, she went back to the script...!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, it was. And we wouldn't have been able to do it on our own. We were able to put on a great show because our fans were willing to help us.

rows.Speaker: Marina
rows.Line:
Yeah, I heard!
Apparently, MMJ has been putting on all sorts of events with the help of their fans!

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: And they made the outfits you're wearing, right? They're so cute! I love them!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Y-Yes, they did...!
We were really worried about what outfits to wear since it's our first time appearing on TV...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But we decided to wear these for this appearance because we wanted to tell all our fans just how much we appreciate what they've done for us!

rows.Speaker: Marina
rows.Line:
Wow! That's great!
I'm sure they couldn't be happier!

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: So, did your fans also design them?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Actually, Shizuku came up with the base designs. Our fans made them based on what she came up with.

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: Really? Shizuku, you designed these...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I spent quite a lot of time thinking about how to design them since it was my first time doing anything like this. And when I tried to look up what certain flowers symbolize...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: For some reason, I ended up opening a map that I couldn't close. I was so confused.

rows.Speaker: Marina
rows.Line: Wait, you were looking up information on flowers and ended up on a map?! And you couldn't close it?! How'd that happen?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, um... Shizuku and electronics don't exactly get along...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Just the other day, she told us that her phone wouldn't turn on, but we found out later that the charger wasn't plugged in all the way.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
H-Haruka...
That's really embarrassing...
se_event_thread_2023_006

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: So, between helping out for your shows and designing your outfits, you as a group seem to have a much closer relationship with your fans compared to other idols.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, we do.
MORE MORE JUMP! livestreams on a regular basis, so we've made it a point to communicate with our fans.

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line:
I see.
But weren't they a bit disillusioned with you at first?

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: I mean, Shizuku, you're totally different from when you were in Cheerful * Days.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
There you go again!
This question wasn't in the script!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Even after Marina went out of her way to get us back on track.
se_event_thread_2023_006

rows.Speaker: Marina
rows.Line: Arisa, I get that you like being seen as having a sharp tongue, but aren't you going a little too far?

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line:
What?! Aren't any of you curious?!
I mean, she seems to be having way more fun now compared to when she was with us!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Of course, my time with Cheerful * Days was fun.

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line:
Are you sure?
Back then, you had to be the “perfect” Shizuku Hinomori 24/7.

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: But now, you're acting all dopey and telling people about how you and your phone don't get along.

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: Aren't your fans from when you were still in Cheerful * Days going to be disappointed?

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: More to the point, Shizuku, tell us. Which one is the real you?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I, um...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (She's really digging in, but the cameras are still rolling. That must mean...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Like he said during our meeting, this show welcomes these sorts of things. Which explains why Higure's being so...)

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: I'm going to give it everything I have, so I hope you will as well.

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: Well, I already know the answer, but I'm sure our panel here would love to find out...!

rows.Speaker: Group Members
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm sure a lot of other people are also wondering!

rows.Speaker: Group Members
rows.Line: So, it's true? When you were still with Cheerful * Days... That was all for show?

rows.Speaker: Marina
rows.Line: Whoa, they seem pretty eager to find out...

rows.Speaker: Marina
rows.Line:
S-So, Shizuku...
I know it's a tough question, but would you be willing to give us an answer...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Shizuku...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Of course.
I'm sure, like you've all said, quite a few people out there are probably wondering.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Please allow me to take this opportunity to clarify things. When I was still a member of Cheerful * Days...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I was playing someone who I wasn't.

rows.Speaker: Marina
rows.Line:
What?! Really?!
But... Why?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: This is going to sound like a terrible excuse, but it's because I had very little confidence in myself...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Which is why I admired those who could accomplish anything flawlessly... I also wanted to be “perfect”...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, I thought I could achieve that by playing someone who could.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Shizuku's saying that like it was her idea.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Even though it was really her agency's...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: However, I had trouble accomplishing that on my own. As a result, I often ended up asking everyone from Cheerful * Days for their help...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
No, not just them...
Everyone from the agency staff to those who asked me to make appearances for them...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Which ultimately led to me leaving the group and disappointing my fans... I had no right being the lead to begin with.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm very sorry for what I did...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Group Members
rows.Line: Yeah, we know you had it rough back then, and couldn't say anything until now!

rows.Speaker: Group Members
rows.Line: Too true. You might've had a script each time, but we knew that the real you was a clumsy person. I was always so scared that you'd say something that could be taken the wrong way!

rows.Speaker: Group Members
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
It felt like we were walking on eggshells every time someone asked something off-script!

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: I remember a time when she was asked how she liked to take her coffee and she started talking about tea. We really struggled with that one!
se_event_thread_2023_006

rows.Speaker: Marina
rows.Line: O-O-Okay then... It sounds like the third generation has a lot to say regarding this...

rows.Speaker: Marina
rows.Line:
But should we really keep going?
This discussion's sort of turning into something you hear at an all-girls high school!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I don't mind...
It's all true and I knew that I'd have to speak openly about this someday.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Also, I realized something...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The me from Cheerful * Days and the current me are one and the same.

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: As I just mentioned, I was able to play the “perfect” version of myself because I had the help of the staff and everyone else.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, when I joined MORE MORE JUMP! after leaving Cheerful * Days and heard that we'd be focusing on doing livestreams...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I realized that I wouldn't be able to keep up my act...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I knew how clumsy and ungraceful the real me was, so I was worried about how those who've been longtime fans of mine would feel when they were faced with the truth...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, it went beyond that. I was afraid that they wouldn't be willing to accept me for who I really am.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
However, I chose to just be myself.
Which...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Which made me realize how there are some things that only the real me had to offer. And I found that some were willing to accept me for who I really am...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, even if I end up disappointing some of my old fans, I'm going to keep doing my best to spread hope to as many people as I can... As myself.

rows.Speaker: Marina
rows.Line:
That's so brave of you...
Especially since playing the old you sort of would've helped maintain your fan base while keeping naysayers from poking fun at you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, but...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: To my surprise, many were willing to accept me for who I really am.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: As nervous as I was about doing this, their warmth helped me move forward one step at a time...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And now, like all those who are watching... I feel comfortable with me being this kind of idol.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I finally understand now that it's okay for me to just be myself.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And what I want to do for everyone hasn't changed at all.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
So, just like back then...
I want to keep spreading and inspiring hope in as many people as possible.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I can't tell others who preferred the old me to suddenly have a change of heart.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I want them to know that the me who was in Cheerful * Days and the me who is currently in MORE MORE JUMP! are one and the same.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: For the longest time, I've been meaning to tell all my fans that my feelings about them haven't changed. And that's the absolute truth...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, Arisa, thank you for giving me the opportunity to finally talk about this.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Also, I couldn't be more grateful that idol Hazard gave us this wonderful opportunity to speak...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I still have a long way to go as an idol, but I'll be looking forward to your continued support...

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: No, I just...

rows.Speaker: Marina
rows.Line:
That was so cool!!!
It takes so much courage to just be yourself and tell the truth like that on TV!

rows.Speaker: Marina
rows.Line: I'm officially one of your fans now, Shizuku! So, let's keep the questions coming!

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line:
Geez, Marina, you're so easy...
Also, we just used up a lot of our time...

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: So, why don't we go in order one by one? And we'll stay on script this time!
se_event_thread_2023_006

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I wasn't sure what was gonna happen there, but she figured it out.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I doubt Shizuku could've predicted that something like this would happen today...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (But you're way more amazing than any stupid character that your old agency made you play...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (You really are the best idol ever!)
